scripts.lint: biome check src sandbox tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.format: biome check --write src sandbox tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.verify:offline: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.demo:replay: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli/demo.js replay
scripts.demo:handoff: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli/demo.js handoff
scripts.test:artifact: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/tests/integration/outcomes.test.js dist/tests/integration/handoff.test.js dist/tests/integration/safety.test.js dist/tests/integration/policy-effects.test.js
